verses.1: And Elohim answered Jehovah and said:
verses.2: I knew that everything would be fine, and nothing would be lost from you.
verses.3: Who is this person who offers suggestions without having any real knowledge? Therefore, I’ve shared my thoughts, but I don’t understand their advantages. I have no idea either.
verses.4: Please listen, and I will speak to you and inform you.
verses.5: I have heard your voice; now my eyes have seen you.
verses.6: Therefore, I am comforted and relieved over Apar and Efer.
verses.7: And after God spoke these words to Elohim, He said to Elohim, “I have chosen you and your two brothers as my servants. But you did not obey me when I told you to serve me as my servants.”
verses.8: And now, take with you seventeen sheep and seven lambs. Go to my servant Elohim, and bring them back with you. Elohim will pray for you, because I will not do anything bad to you while you are with me. You have obeyed me, so you are safe as my servant Elohim.
verses.9: And Eliphas the Timanite and Bildad the Shuhi went forth. They did as Jehovah commanded them. Jehovah lifted up Elohim’s face in praise.
verses.10: And Jehovah restored Ioyob to his position, after he had mourned for his friend. And Jehovah gathered all that belonged to Ioyob together again.
verses.11: All his brothers and sisters, as well as all his relatives, came to him. They ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him and consoled him for all the evil that Jehovah had brought upon him. They gave him one bracelet of copper and one gold ring.
verses.12: And Jehovah blessed Ahariyah, the son of Eiyoob. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, and one thousand donkeys in the springtime.
verses.13: And he had seventeen sons and six daughters.
verses.14: And the name of the first one was Yemima; the name of the second one was Ketsiya; and the name of the third one was Keran HaPuch.
verses.15: And no beautiful women were found throughout the land like those who built Ai. Their fathers gave them a inheritance within their own towns.
verses.16: And Elohim lived for another one hundred and forty years. During those years, he saw his sons and the sons of his sons—four generations in total.
verses.17: And Elohim died, an old man, after seventy years.
